stories.head: Rocket Lab's $8 billion gamble on Iridium
stories.body: Rocket Lab has announced its acquisition of Iridium for $8 billion, a strategic move that CEO Peter Beck describes as the 'logical next step.' With this acquisition, Rocket Lab aims to bolster its position in the space services sector, but one has to wonder if they’re simply trying to play catch-up in a crowded market. Iridium's existing infrastructure might offer Rocket Lab a shortcut to credibility, but it also raises questions about their organic growth strategy.
stories.soWhat: If Rocket Lab is banking on Iridium to redefine its identity, they better hope it’s not just a shiny distraction from deeper issues.

stories.head: FY27 budget adds $1.4B for space resilience
stories.body: The recent FY27 budget markup has allocated an additional $1.4 billion for space resilience initiatives, marking a significant acknowledgment of the vulnerabilities in our orbital operations. This funding is a clear signal from lawmakers that they recognize space as more than just a sci-fi backdrop. However, whether this money translates into actionable improvements remains to be seen, as bureaucratic inertia often stifles timely progress.
stories.soWhat: More money doesn’t guarantee better outcomes; it just makes the stakes higher if nothing changes.

stories.head: Quantum computing emerges as a security concern
stories.body: As quantum computing technology advances, it is increasingly viewed as a national security risk in orbit, particularly regarding encryption vulnerabilities. This emerging threat is prompting defense contractors to reassess their strategies and technologies. While the implications are serious, the race to develop quantum-resistant solutions is likely to generate a wave of new contracts and partnerships, but it also risks becoming the next buzzword bingo in government discussions.
stories.soWhat: If the military gets too caught up in the quantum hype, we might end up with more funding for buzzwords than actual solutions.

watchlist.title: Watch Rocket Lab's integration of Iridium
watchlist.body: The success of Rocket Lab's acquisition hinges on how quickly they can integrate Iridium's assets into their operations.

watchlist.title: Impact of new budget on startups
watchlist.body: The increased budget for space resilience could open doors for startups focused on defense and security solutions.

watchlist.title: ESA's lunar mapping RFP expected soon

watchlist.title: Monitor developments in quantum computing
watchlist.body: As quantum computing becomes a focal point for national security, related companies may see increased attention from investors.

talent.head: Demand has doubled. So has our hit rate.
talent.body: EVONA's job orders are up 2.0× year-over-year, and for the first time in our eight-year history we're placing two new starters per EVONA staff member. The first number says demand is real. The second says we're converting it, which in recruitment is the only number that actually matters. Growth is heaviest in Series B/C startups; primes are running flat. Compensation isn't the variable. The constraint is schedule risk in the primes: senior engineers leave Boeing, Lockheed, Northrop because they want to ship hardware before retirement.
